_meta.status: DRAFT — BLOCKING gates before publish: (1) regulated-sector quarantine done, (2) one UAE legal review pass signed off, (3) scanner returns zero. Do not deploy before all three.
_meta.site: mychef.ae — ~180 pages, JS-rendered (React/SPA), programmatic SEO. Full list in sitemap.xml.
_meta.goal: Stop the brand claiming it COOKS/CATERS or that it EMPLOYS, SUPPLIES or PLACES chefs. Reposition as an experience brand that DESIGNS the occasion and INTRODUCES/RECOMMENDS independent licensed chefs the client engages; the chef performs the regulated work. Resolves the management-consultancy-vs-catering gap (HC-03/HC-28).
PRIME_RULES: TEST 1 — Performance: 'Does this claim WE cook/cater/prepare/serve?' If yes -> rewrite so the chef does it.

TEST 2 — Chef relationship: 'Does this claim we EMPLOY, SUPPLY, PLACE or STAFF the chef?' If yes -> rewrite to INTRODUCE / MATCH / RECOMMEND independent chefs the client engages. (Employment AND manpower-supply are separate regulated activities the licence does not cover — flagged by legal red-team.)

TEST 3 — Control: avoid 'we manage/control DELIVERY to our standard' about the COOKING. It's fine to say we DESIGN the experience and SELECT chefs to a high standard; it is risky to claim we operationally control the food service.
_meta.keep: ALL SEO keywords stay: the noun 'catering', 'private chef', every /*-catering-dubai URL/title/H1. Only the CLAIM of performing/employing changes. EXCEPTION: the HOMEPAGE hero title/H1 is deliberately repositioned from 'Luxury Catering' to 'Luxury Dining Experiences' (owner-approved brand move, DOS-BLU-002); this exception applies ONLY to the homepage hero, not to the ~100 occasion/catering page titles which KEEP 'Catering'.
how_to_apply: STEP 0 (BLOCKING) — Quarantine: noindex + 301 the regulated-sector pages in `pre_step_quarantine` to a generic page BEFORE rewording. A lawyer per-sector go/no-go decides which return. The scanner does NOT substitute for this.

STEP 1 — Locate copy: this is a React/SPA + programmatic site, so strings live in components and/or a CMS/data layer, NOT static HTML. Grep the repo/CMS for each find-string; report match count per file; FAIL LOUDLY on any zero-match find-string (means the string moved — re-scan the live page).
STEP 2 — Deterministic swaps: apply `global.find_replace_exact` and every template `find_replace` verbatim.
STEP 3 — Guided rewrite: apply `global.phrase_map` across ALL pages and ALL surfaces. Each row has ONE canonical replacement; use it, adapting grammar only.

STEP 4 — Surfaces: apply steps 2–3 to EVERY surface in `global.surfaces` (not just body): <title>, meta description, og:/twitter: tags, image alt + captions, breadcrumbs, nav, 'You May Also Like' cards, AND regenerate all JSON-LD from the reworded copy.
STEP 5 — Additions: add `global.additions` to every page.

STEP 6 (BLOCKING) — Scanner: run `global.scanner` CASE-INSENSITIVELY over the RENDERED DOM text + head + JSON-LD of every one of the ~180 pages. Every pattern must return ZERO. Also run `global.positive_assertions` — each must PASS.
STEP 7 (BLOCKING) — one UAE legal review pass, then publish from staging.
_meta.coverage_note: All 180 URLs from sitemap.xml. Live-scanned templates: homepage, occasion-catering (wedding), chef page (our-chefs). The phrase_map + case-insensitive scanner are the safety net for the ~150 templated pages not hand-scanned. STEP 1 grep + STEP 6 scanner catch anything the exact pairs miss.
do_not: Do NOT change any URL (SEO + 301 risk) — except the STEP-0 quarantine redirects.
Do NOT claim HACCP / 'licensed caterer' about myCHEF itself.
Do NOT keep any named chef presented as an employee.
Do NOT use any replacement token containing the literal 'our chef' (it trips the scanner and re-asserts employment).
